observations: Photo 0 and 1 show the front of a solar panel with a white frame and a grid of dark cells.
Photo 2 and 3 show the back of the same panel, which is white with three black cable lugs.
The panel is shown leaning against a wall in a cluttered indoor or semi-indoor space.
Watermarks for 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' and 'JIJI' are present on all photos.
No brand name, model number, or technical specification label is visible on the panel in any photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may be a low-quality generic brand rather than a reputable manufacturer.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be used or have internal damage despite the clean appearance.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be a counterfeit or a different wattage than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's output voltage and current.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
